card.name: Live vaccines and induced emesis
card.fires_on: The word "live" before vaccine terms, and "induction" or the "of" after it in "induction of emesis". It appears in immunization warnings and overdose treatment text.

modes.label: Live vaccines
modes.description: The word "live" before vaccine or attenuated vaccine in immunization warnings.

modes.label: Induction of emesis
modes.description: The word induction, or the "of" after it, in overdose advice about inducing vomiting.
